scenario.zh: 向学校场地办公室申请大型活动场地
scenario.en: Requesting a large-event venue from a university office

body.zh:
主题：ACSSY [活动名] 场地申请 — [日期]

您好，

我是耶鲁中国学生学者联合会（ACSSY）[部门] 的 [姓名]。我们计划于 [日期] [时间] 举办 [活动名]，预计 [人数] 人参加，希望申请 [场地]。

活动内容：[一句话]
需要设施：[投影 / 音响 / 餐饮许可]
负责人联系方式：[邮箱 / 电话]

附件为活动方案与保险证明。感谢您的支持！

[姓名]
ACSSY [部门]
body.en:
Subject: ACSSY [event] venue request — [date]

Hello,

I'm [name] from the [department] of the Association of Chinese Students and Scholars at Yale (ACSSY). We plan to host [event] on [date] at [time] for about [N] guests and would like to request [venue].

Event summary: [one line]
Facilities needed: [projector / sound / catering permit]
Organizer contact: [email / phone]

The event plan and insurance certificate are attached. Thank you for your support!

[name]
ACSSY [department]

tips.zh: 附件一定带保险证明；提前 8 周；抄送指导老师。
tips.en: Always attach the insurance certificate; send 8 weeks ahead; cc the advisor.

scenario.zh: 首次联系潜在赞助商（通常由校友介绍）
scenario.en: First contact with a potential sponsor (usually via an alumni intro)

body.zh:
主题：耶鲁 ACSSY [活动名] 合作邀请

[称呼] 您好，

经 [校友姓名] 介绍与您联系。ACSSY 是耶鲁规模最大的中国学生学者组织，覆盖约 [N] 名在校生与校友。我们将于 [日期] 举办 [活动名]，预计 [人数] 人参加。

我们希望邀请贵司成为 [级别] 合作伙伴，权益包括：海报与推送 logo 露出、现场展位 / 宣讲 [时长]、校友名单触达（经同意）。

附件为合作方案，期待进一步沟通。

[姓名]
ACSSY 外联部
body.en:
Subject: Partnership invitation — Yale ACSSY [event]

Dear [name],

[Alumni name] suggested I reach out. ACSSY is Yale's largest Chinese student and scholar organization, reaching about [N] students and alumni. We are hosting [event] on [date] with an expected [N] attendees.

We would like to invite [company] as a [tier] partner. Benefits include logo placement on posters and posts, an on-site booth / [duration] info session, and opt-in access to our alumni list.

The partnership deck is attached. Looking forward to talking further.

[name]
ACSSY Outreach

tips.zh: 先由介绍人拉群或转发，再发正式邮件；方案控制在 5 页内。
tips.en: Have the introducer make the first move, then send the formal email; keep the deck under five pages.

scenario.zh: 活动前 3–4 周在本站与微信群发布
scenario.en: Post 3–4 weeks before the event, here and in WeChat groups

body.zh:
【招募】[活动名] 志愿者 [N] 名

时间：[日期 时间]
地点：[场地]
岗位：签到 [N] / 后勤 [N] / 摄影 [N] / 舞台 [N]

志愿者福利：活动免费入场、志愿时长证明、学联周边。

报名：在 YaleLink「学联后台 → 志愿者」页面点击报名，或联系 [负责人]。
截止：[日期]
body.en:
[Volunteers wanted] [event] — [N] spots

When: [date, time]
Where: [venue]
Roles: check-in [N] / logistics [N] / photography [N] / stage [N]

Perks: free entry, volunteer-hours certificate, ACSSY merch.

Sign up: YaleLink → ACSSY console → Volunteers, or contact [lead].
Deadline: [date]

tips.zh: 岗位写清楚时段；报名后 48 小时内回复确认。
tips.en: State shifts per role; confirm sign-ups within 48 hours.

scenario.zh: 公众号 / 群公告 / 本站推送
scenario.en: Official account / group notice / site push

body.zh:
🎉 [活动名] 来了！

📅 [日期 时间]
📍 [场地]
🎫 [免费 / 票价]，[人数] 席位

[两句话说清楚为什么值得来]

👉 报名：YaleLink 活动页 [链接]
⏰ 截止 [日期]，先到先得。
body.en:
🎉 [Event] is here!

📅 [date, time]
📍 [venue]
🎫 [free / price], [N] seats

[Two sentences on why it's worth coming]

👉 RSVP: YaleLink event page [link]
⏰ Closes [date], first come first served.

tips.zh: 推送三次：开放报名、截止前 3 天、活动前 1 天。
tips.en: Push three times: opening, three days before close, the day before.

scenario.zh: 邀请校友做分享会嘉宾
scenario.en: Inviting an alum to speak at a panel

body.zh:
主题：邀请您参加 ACSSY [活动名]（[日期]）

[校友姓名] 学长/学姐好，

我是 ACSSY 职业发展部的 [姓名]。今年 [行业] 校招节奏变化很大，同学们非常希望听到您的一线经验。我们计划于 [日期] 举办 [活动名]，形式为 [圆桌 / 讲座]，时长约 [N] 分钟，线上线下同步。

提纲（供参考）：
1. [话题一]
2. [话题二]
3. Q&A

如您方便，我们会负责所有会务与差旅报销。期待您的回复！

[姓名]
body.en:
Subject: Invitation to speak at ACSSY [event] ([date])

Dear [alumni name],

I'm [name] from ACSSY Career Development. [Industry] recruiting has changed a lot this year and students would love to hear your first-hand view. We're hosting [event] on [date] as a [panel / talk] of about [N] minutes, hybrid.

Suggested outline:
1. [topic one]
2. [topic two]
3. Q&A

We'll handle all logistics and travel reimbursement. Looking forward to hearing from you!

[name]

tips.zh: 提前 3 周；提纲不超过 3 点；确认后发日历邀请。
tips.en: Three weeks ahead; outline no more than three points; send a calendar invite once confirmed.

name.zh: 活动后感谢 & 反馈问卷

scenario.zh: 活动结束 24 小时内发送
scenario.en: Send within 24 hours after the event

body.zh:
感谢参加 [活动名]！

照片已上传：[链接]
请花 1 分钟填写反馈：[问卷链接]

问卷问题（建议）：
1. 整体满意度（1–5）
2. 最有收获的环节
3. 希望下次改进的一点
4. 是否愿意成为志愿者 / 讲者

下次活动预告：[活动名，日期]
body.en:
Thanks for joining [event]!

Photos: [link]
One minute of feedback, please: [survey link]

Suggested questions:
1. Overall satisfaction (1–5)
2. Most valuable part
3. One thing to improve
4. Would you volunteer / speak next time?

Next up: [event, date]

tips.zh: 反馈整理进 SOP 的「历史记录」，这是后来人最需要的。
tips.en: Fold the feedback into the playbook's history — it's what the next organizer needs most.
